Sampled HR@10 with 99 negatives can disagree with full-catalog performance and reverse model rankings; popularity sampling does not guarantee agreement. Foundational [sampling analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.02263) and a [2025 RecSys study](https://doi.org/10.1145/3705328.3748086) identify candidate selection, exposure bias and sample size as drivers. Consequently, full-catalog disagreement is a useful stress diagnostic, but cannot replace this benchmark’s fixed sampled objective. Popularity-stratified hard negatives probe different failure modes; unobserved interactions remain unknown preferences, so hard negatives may include relevant items.

Suggested diagnostic design, rather than an established result for these four datasets: fix training-history probes and candidate pools; stratify items by training popularity; measure positive-rank percentiles, pairwise win rates and sampled/full-catalog hit disagreement. These rank statistics survive strictly increasing score transformations; raw margins and softmax entropy do not survive arbitrary temperature changes. Test whether diagnostics predict subsequent macro validation HR@10 improvements across all four categories, controlling for checkpoint age, training loss and popularity-only baselines. Twenty simulator users support qualitative inspection, not population-level validation.

For uncertainty, resample paired users within each category and average the four category gains equally; report confidence intervals and category-specific effects. This conditions on the fixed candidates and training seed. [Recommendation inference research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.02461) supports bootstrap/randomization approaches, but ordinary bootstrap intervals do not correct adaptive model selection. [Adaptive-data-analysis theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629) establishes the danger of repeated holdout reuse. Keep the host evaluator unchanged; predeclare diagnostic hypotheses, limit validation queries, log every trial, and treat post-selection intervals as descriptive. No retrieved evidence establishes these probes as reliable predictors for this exact benchmark.
